name: SkillGym-Qwen3.5-122B-A10B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 36 of 48 layers are linear_attention and 12 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (SkillGym SFT on 19k verified successful trajectories from three teacher models), not a new base model: same config.json, same tensor set 51 shards / 250.17 GB index total. params_b 121.349 is the language-model count, not the safetensors total, for the same reason as the base record: the index still carries the vision tower (model.visual.*) and MTP block even though the card serves it text-only via MiniSwe-Agent. Recorded because the card prints one table with a base row and a this-model row; it is the strongest evidence in the batch (four benchmarks, all higher, the agent-skill axis gaining 38.1 points on Skill-Use-Bench). Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-26.
